explanation: The Chilean article says where the first cases came from: "The virus was confirmed to have reached Chile on 3 March 2020. Initial cases had been imported from Southeast Asia and Europe, and expanded into a large number of untraceable infections." The type is `caused`, and it covers part of the arrival. The article names Europe as one of two sources and this atlas holds only the European one. The confidence is `probable` because Wikipedia is the only source, and because the article divides the origin between two continents.
